# Kern

> Kern UI by Xoroh — an open-source design system following Material
> Design 3. One contract, web and native. Full docs: /docs

## AI agents

Prefer these machine surfaces over scraping HTML:
- /llms.txt (this file) — the complete page map, generated from the nav, the content docs and the foundations registry
- Per-page markdown at /md/{web|mobile}/<slug>.md and /md/foundations/<slug>.md — same content the page renders, linked from every component and Foundations page via its View .md affordance
- /mcp/index.json — the whole docs corpus as data: title, one-liner, page route, and .md URL per page
- Copy as Markdown button on every component and Foundations page — page prose + code + links, live-demo controls excluded
- Agent skills in the repo: .agents/skills/kern/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/kern-agents/SKILL.md and .agents/skills/docs/SKILL.md (https://github.com/xoroh/kern/tree/main/.agents/skills)

## Overview

- [Design systems](/foundations): The systems kern documents — M3 today, shaped for more

## Material 3

- [Material 3](/foundations/m3): The current system — tokens, theme, and the layer beneath
- [Tokens](/foundations/m3/tokens): The token architecture — naming, roles, bands
- [Color](/foundations/m3/color): M3 role system, pairing law, usage rules
- [Typography](/foundations/m3/type): M3 type scale, specimens, roles
- [Shape](/foundations/m3/shape): M3 corner scale and shape ladder
- [Elevation](/foundations/m3/elevation): M3 levels, shadows, surface depth
- [Motion](/foundations/m3/motion): Easing, durations, springs
- [States](/foundations/m3/states): State layers, interaction states, focus
- [Theme](/foundations/m3/theme): M3 color roles in the active theme

## Primitives

- [Primitives](/primitives): Headless behavior kernel for web and native
- [useControllableState](/primitives/use-controllable-state): One state hook for controlled/uncontrolled components
- [Dismiss policy](/primitives/dismiss-policy): One dismissal rule for escape / outside-press / pointer-down
- [Dismiss wiring](/primitives/dismiss-wiring): Wiring helpers that connect dismiss sources to the dismissal policy
- [Focus trap](/primitives/focus-trap): Focus-trap model: tab cycling bounds and autofocus resolution
- [Overlay modality](/primitives/overlay-modality): Tracks which overlay layer owns the keyboard and screen-reader focus
- [Portal](/primitives/portal): Portal registry and target resolution
- [Positioning](/primitives/positioning): Floating-position math: origin, rect, viewport clamping
- [Presence](/primitives/presence): Mount/unmount presence states
- [Press](/primitives/press): Press phases and activation keys
- [Roving focus](/primitives/roving): Roving-tabindex keyboard focus for toolbars, tabs, menus
- [Selection](/primitives/selection): Selection helpers shared by both renderers
- [Slot](/primitives/slot): Slot prop merging and handler composition
- [Time](/primitives/time): Time-value formatting and normalization
- [A11y helpers](/primitives/a11y): Id scopes, direction resolution, visually-hidden styles

## Foundations pages (Material 3)

- [Tokens](/foundations/m3/tokens): The named values everything else is built from.
- [Color](/foundations/m3/color): Roles are decisions, not colours — and kern ships more of them than Material 3 does.
- [Typography](/foundations/m3/type): Thirty styles, each rendered by its own tokens.
- [Shape](/foundations/m3/shape): The corner scale, including Material 3's Expressive additions.
- [Elevation](/foundations/m3/elevation): Six levels, and which components rest at which.
- [Motion](/foundations/m3/motion): Spring first, easing as the fallback.
- [States](/foundations/m3/states): What happens to a surface when it is hovered, pressed, dragged or disabled.

## Core primitives

- [Accordion](/core/accordion): Accordions stack collapsible sections, so a long page can be scanned as headings first. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/accordion.md, /md/mobile/accordion.md.
- [Alert dialog](/core/alert-dialog): Alert dialogs interrupt for a decision that must be made before anything else continues. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/alert-dialog.md, /md/mobile/alert-dialog.md.
- [App shell](/core/app-shell): The app shell is the frame around everything else — top bar, rail, drawer, status bar — with every region optional. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/app-shell.md, /md/mobile/app-shell.md.
- [Aspect ratio](/core/aspect-ratio): Aspect ratio boxes keep a fixed width-to-height ratio, whatever width they are given. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/aspect-ratio.md.
- [Autocomplete](/core/autocomplete): Autocompletes suggest values as someone types, and fill in the one they mean. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/autocomplete.md, /md/mobile/autocomplete.md.
- [Avatar](/core/avatar): Avatars show who something belongs to, as an image or as initials. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/avatar.md, /md/mobile/avatar.md.
- [Badge](/core/badge): Badges flag a small, countable change on something that already has a label. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/badge.md, /md/mobile/badge.md.
- [Banner](/core/banner): Banners report something the whole screen needs to know, without blocking what people are doing. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/banner.md, /md/mobile/banner.md.
- [Bottom app bar](/core/bottom-app-bar): Bottom app bar docks actions leading with a trailing FAB on compact screens. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/bottom-app-bar.md, /md/mobile/bottom-app-bar.md.
- [Button group](/core/button-group): Button groups join buttons into one segmented control. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/button-group.md, /md/mobile/button-group.md.
- [Calendar](/core/calendar): Calendars pick a single date from a month grid. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/calendar.md, /md/mobile/calendar.md.
- [Card](/core/card): Cards group related content and actions into a single surface. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/card.md, /md/mobile/card.md.
- [Carousel](/core/carousel): Carousels show one slide at a time from a set, moved through with controls or by gesture. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/carousel.md, /md/mobile/carousel.md.
- [Checkbox](/core/checkbox): Checkboxes let people pick several things from a set, or agree to something one at a time. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/checkbox.md, /md/mobile/checkbox.md.
- [Checkbox group](/core/checkbox-group): A checkbox group collects several independent choices into one value you can read at once. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/checkbox-group.md, /md/mobile/checkbox-group.md.
- [Chip](/core/chip): Chips are compact elements that represent an attribute, an action, or a filter. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/chip.md, /md/mobile/chip.md.
- [Collapsible](/core/collapsible): Collapsibles hide a section of content behind a trigger and show it on demand. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/collapsible.md, /md/mobile/collapsible.md.
- [Combobox](/core/combobox): Comboboxes pick one value from a set, either from the list or by typing to narrow it. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/combobox.md, /md/mobile/combobox.md.
- [Context menu](/core/context-menu): Context menus offer the actions for a thing where the thing is, opened by right-clicking it. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/context-menu.md, /md/mobile/context-menu.md.
- [ContrastToggle](/core/contrast-toggle): One action that requests a contrast change, named for where the press goes rather than where it is. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/contrast-toggle.md.
- [Country select](/core/country-select): Country selects pick a country from a list, showing its flag and dial code alongside its name. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/country-select.md, /md/mobile/country-select.md.
- [Dialog](/core/dialog): A dialog asks people to complete a focused task before they carry on with the rest of the app. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/dialog.md, /md/mobile/dialog.md.
- [Drawer](/core/drawer): A drawer is a panel that slides up from the bottom edge for a short, self-contained step. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/drawer.md, /md/mobile/drawer.md.
- [Empty state](/core/empty-state): Empty states say what is missing, and offer the one thing that would fix it. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/empty-state.md, /md/mobile/empty-state.md.
- [Extended FAB](/core/extended-fab): Extended FABs are the labelled floating action button — the one primary action, with its name beside its icon. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/extended-fab.md, /md/mobile/extended-fab.md.
- [Floating action button](/core/fab): The floating action button is the single most important action on a screen. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/fab.md, /md/mobile/fab.md.
- [FAB menu](/core/fab-menu): FAB menus hold several related actions behind one floating button, opened on tap. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/fab-menu.md, /md/mobile/fab-menu.md.
- [Fieldset](/core/fieldset): Fieldsets group related controls under one legend and give them a shared disabled state. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/fieldset.md, /md/mobile/fieldset.md.
- [Focus ring](/core/focus-ring): Focus rings paint the visible keyboard-focus treatment on host content. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/focus-ring.md.
- [Form](/core/form): Forms collect several values and hand them over together. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/form.md, /md/mobile/form.md.
- [Icon button target](/core/icon-button-target): Icon button targets are the touch-target wrapper that brings a small button up to the platform minimum. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/icon-button-target.md.
- [Input OTP](/core/input-otp): OTP inputs take a short numeric code one character at a time, as it is typed. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/input-otp.md, /md/mobile/input-otp.md.
- [Kbd](/core/kbd): Kbds show a keyboard key or shortcut as text, in the shape of a key. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/kbd.md, /md/mobile/kbd.md.
- [Kern error boundary](/core/kern-error-boundary): The kern error boundary catches a thrown render, shows your fallback with a working reset, and never reloads the page to recover. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/kern-error-boundary.md.
- [Kern pressable](/core/kern-pressable): The narrow accessibility-defaults wrap for anything pressable on native: Material's minimum touch target, a button role by default, and `disabled` always reported. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/kern-pressable.md.
- [Kern tabs](/core/kern-tabs): Kern tabs is the one tab strip with primary and secondary levels over a data contract. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/kern-tabs.md, /md/mobile/kern-tabs.md.
- [Label](/core/label): Labels name the control they sit beside. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/label.md, /md/mobile/label.md.
- [Linear progress](/core/linear-progress): Linear progress shows how much of a task is done, as a bar across a width. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/linear-progress.md, /md/mobile/linear-progress.md.
- [Link](/core/link): Links are anchors that can be pointed at your host router, so kern never hardcodes one. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/link.md.
- [List detail](/core/list-detail): List detail is the phone-width master–detail pattern: the list until an item is selected, then the detail with a way back. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/list-detail.md.
- [List item](/core/list-item): List items are rows in a list — a headline, optional supporting text, and optional leading and trailing slots. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/list-item.md, /md/mobile/list-item.md.
- [Loader](/core/loader): Loaders say something is happening, in the space where it is happening. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/loader.md, /md/mobile/loader.md.
- [Loading indicator](/core/loading-indicator): Loading indicators are the labelled spinner — a wait with its name attached. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/loading-indicator.md, /md/mobile/loading-indicator.md.
- [Loading region](/core/loading-region): Loading regions swap between content and a loading state as work starts and finishes. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/loading-region.md.
- [Menu](/core/menu): Menus list the actions available on something, opened from the control that owns them. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/menu.md, /md/mobile/menu.md.
- [Menubar](/core/menubar): A menubar is a horizontal row of menus, the way an application exposes its commands. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/menubar.md, /md/mobile/menubar.md.
- [Meter](/core/meter): Meters show a value against a range, so a quantity can be read at a glance. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/meter.md, /md/mobile/meter.md.
- [Native select](/core/native-select): Native selects are the browser's own dropdown, styled to sit with the rest of a form. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/native-select.md.
- [Navigation bar](/core/navigation-bar): The navigation bar is the compact-screen destination switcher that sits along the bottom edge. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/navigation-bar.md, /md/mobile/navigation-bar.md.
- [Navigation bar item](/core/navigation-bar-item): Navigation bar items are one destination row for vertical containers — a drawer, a rail or a sidebar list. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/navigation-bar-item.md.
- [Navigation menu](/core/navigation-menu): Navigation menus open a panel of links from a trigger in a site's main navigation. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/navigation-menu.md, /md/mobile/navigation-menu.md.
- [Navigation rail](/core/navigation-rail): The navigation rail is the persistent vertical navigation surface — icon-only by default, a labelled sidebar when expanded. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/navigation-rail.md.
- [Number field](/core/number-field): Number fields take a number from someone, with steppers to nudge it up and down. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/number-field.md, /md/mobile/number-field.md.
- [Pagination](/core/pagination): Pagination moves through a long set of results one page at a time. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/pagination.md, /md/mobile/pagination.md.
- [Pane](/core/pane): Panes are content regions on a width scale, and the layout shapes built from them — a page, a split, a list-and-detail. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/pane.md, /md/mobile/pane.md.
- [Popover](/core/popover): Popovers surface a small panel of content or controls next to whatever opened them. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/popover.md, /md/mobile/popover.md.
- [Preview card](/core/preview-card): Preview cards show a richer look at a link's destination before anyone commits to going there. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/preview-card.md.
- [Progress](/core/progress): Progress indicators show how much of something is done while it is still running. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/progress.md, /md/mobile/progress.md.
- [Radio group](/core/radio-group): Radio groups let people pick exactly one option from a set they can see all at once. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/radio-group.md, /md/mobile/radio-group.md.
- [Rich tooltip](/core/rich-tooltip): A tooltip with a subhead, supporting text, and plain-text actions for explanations that need more than a label. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/rich-tooltip.md, /md/mobile/rich-tooltip.md.
- [Scroll area](/core/scroll-area): Scroll areas give a fixed region its own scrollbar, so the page does not scroll away from under the content. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/scroll-area.md, /md/mobile/scroll-area.md.
- [Blocks](/core/search-bar): Blocks are the small shell pieces — a search bar, a settings row, a status bar, and the theme and contrast toggles. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/search-bar.md.
- [Segmented button](/core/segmented-button): Segmented buttons show a small set of options side by side, with the chosen one visibly selected. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/segmented-button.md, /md/mobile/segmented-button.md.
- [Select](/core/select): Selects let someone choose one value from a set too long to show on the page. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/select.md, /md/mobile/select.md.
- [Select group](/core/select-group): Select groups collect related options under one label inside the open list. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/select-group.md.
- [Separator](/core/separator): Separators divide one region of content from the next. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/separator.md, /md/mobile/separator.md.
- [Settings row](/core/settings-row): Settings rows pair a label and supporting text with the control that owns them. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/settings-row.md.
- [Shape](/core/shape): Shapes are the six basic forms in the kern radius language, drawn from the shape scale rather than freehand. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/shape.md.
- [Sheet](/core/sheet): Sheets slide in from the side to hold a focused task beside the content behind them. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/sheet.md, /md/mobile/sheet.md.
- [Skeleton](/core/skeleton): Skeletons stand in for content that is still loading, in the shape it will have. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/skeleton.md, /md/mobile/skeleton.md.
- [Slider](/core/slider): Sliders pick a value from a range by feel, showing where it sits along the way. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/slider.md, /md/mobile/slider.md.
- [Snackbar](/core/snackbar): Snackbars confirm something happened, briefly, without interrupting what someone is doing. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/snackbar.md.
- [Snackbar](/core/snackbar-provider): Snackbars confirm something happened, briefly, with an optional action to undo it. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/snackbar-provider.md.
- [Split](/core/split): The split is an N-column layout: two or three equal columns divided by a hairline, named as one region for assistive technology. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/split.md, /md/mobile/split.md.
- [Split button](/core/split-button): Split buttons pair one primary action with a menu of related alternatives. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/split-button.md, /md/mobile/split-button.md.
- [State layer](/core/state-layer): The M3 pressed wash for native: an overlay in the content color at the pressed state-layer opacity, clipped to the container shape. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/state-layer.md.
- [Status bar](/core/status-bar): Status bars hold one centered status with leading and trailing slots. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/status-bar.md.
- [Status pill](/core/status-pill): Status pill is the one-line status label on the tone registry. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/status-pill.md, /md/mobile/status-pill.md.
- [Switch](/core/switch): A switch turns a single setting on or off and applies it at once. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/switch.md, /md/mobile/switch.md.
- [Table](/core/table): Tables lay out rows of related values so they can be compared down a column. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/table.md, /md/mobile/table.md.
- [Tabs](/core/tabs): Tabs switch between related views of the same subject without leaving the page. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/tabs.md, /md/mobile/tabs.md.
- [Text](/core/text): Text renders a line of type at one of the typescale's styles. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/text.md, /md/mobile/text.md.
- [Time picker](/core/time-picker): Time pickers set a time of day with explicit hour and minute fields. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/time-picker.md, /md/mobile/time-picker.md.
- [Toggle](/core/toggle): Toggles are buttons that stay pressed, for a setting you switch on and off. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/toggle.md, /md/mobile/toggle.md.
- [Toggle group](/core/toggle-group): Toggle groups hold related toggles together as one control, picking either one option or several. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/toggle-group.md, /md/mobile/toggle-group.md.
- [Toolbar](/core/toolbar): Toolbars hold the controls that act on the content below them. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/toolbar.md, /md/mobile/toolbar.md.
- [Tooltip](/core/tooltip): Tooltips name or explain a control the moment someone hovers or focuses it. Tier: Core (M3 primitive). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/tooltip.md, /md/mobile/tooltip.md.

## Composite components

- [Action sheet](/components/m3/action-sheet): The action sheet is a titled list of actions in a bottom sheet — the one surface for "what do you want to do with this?" Tier: Component (composite). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/action-sheet.md, /md/mobile/action-sheet.md.
- [Billing page](/components/m3/billing-page): Billing page renders plan and invoice display slots with no payment actions. Tier: Component (composite). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/billing-page.md, /md/mobile/billing-page.md.
- [Boot indicator](/components/m3/boot-indicator): Boot indicators are the branded loading surface shown while the app itself starts. Tier: Component (composite). Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/boot-indicator.md.
- [Boot splash](/components/m3/boot-splash): Boot splashes cover the first moment of an app, with your mark and optional milestone steps. Tier: Component (composite). Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/boot-splash.md.
- [Bottom sheet](/components/m3/bottom-sheet): The bottom sheet is a modal surface anchored to the bottom edge: content, an optional heading and a visible way out. Tier: Component (composite). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/bottom-sheet.md, /md/mobile/bottom-sheet.md.
- [Bottom sheet picker](/components/m3/bottom-sheet-picker): The bottom sheet picker is a selector in a sheet — a titled list of options where the selection is announced, not just tinted. Tier: Component (composite). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/bottom-sheet-picker.md, /md/mobile/bottom-sheet-picker.md.
- [Button](/components/m3/button): Buttons let people carry out an action with a single tap, click or key press. Tier: Component (composite). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/button.md, /md/mobile/button.md.
- [Circular progress](/components/m3/circular-progress): Circular progress shows how much of a task is done, as a ring. Tier: Component (composite). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/circular-progress.md, /md/mobile/circular-progress.md.
- [Command](/components/m3/command): Commands are searchable lists of actions and destinations, filtered as you type. Tier: Component (composite). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/command.md, /md/mobile/command.md.
- [Composer attachment tray](/components/m3/composer-attachment-tray): Composer attachment tray lists draft attachments with removal. Tier: Component (composite). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/composer-attachment-tray.md, /md/mobile/composer-attachment-tray.md.

- [Data table](/components/m3/data-table): Data table is the sortable, pageable grid over columns and rows with four density presets. Tier: Component (composite). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/data-table.md, /md/mobile/data-table.md.
- [Dock sheet](/components/m3/dock-sheet): The dock sheet is a persistent quick-action bar peeking from the bottom edge — a region, not a dialog. Tier: Component (composite). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/dock-sheet.md, /md/mobile/dock-sheet.md.
- [Empty search](/components/m3/empty-search): Empty search is the no-results recovery block that echoes the query and offers to clear it. Tier: Component (composite). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/empty-search.md, /md/mobile/empty-search.md.
- [Entity sheet](/components/m3/entity-sheet): The entity sheet is the read-mostly detail surface for one record — a title, its fields, and at most one action. Tier: Component (composite). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/entity-sheet.md, /md/mobile/entity-sheet.md.
- [Error boundary](/components/m3/error-boundary): Error boundaries catch a thrown render so one broken screen does not blank the whole app. Tier: Component (composite). Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/error-boundary.md.

- [Filter bar](/components/m3/filter-bar): Filter bar turns facet definitions into chips with saved views and a host-owned overflow trigger. Tier: Component (composite). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/filter-bar.md, /md/mobile/filter-bar.md.

- [Sidebar](/components/m3/sidebar): Sidebars are the app's persistent navigation region, composed from a provider, sections and items. Tier: Component (composite). Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/sidebar.md.

- [Success transform](/components/m3/success-transform): Success transforms are the completion moment — a disc and a tick, or the loader that precedes it. Tier: Component (composite). Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/success-transform.md.
- [Supporting pane](/components/m3/supporting-pane): Supporting panes hold the secondary panel beside main content, and hide it entirely on a compact screen. Tier: Component (composite). Renders: Native. Markdown: /md/mobile/supporting-pane.md.
- [Testimonial list](/components/m3/testimonial-list): Testimonial list renders figure cards of customer quotes. Tier: Component (composite). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/testimonial-list.md, /md/mobile/testimonial-list.md.
- [Textarea](/components/m3/textarea): Textareas take several lines of text from someone and hand it to you. Tier: Component (composite). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/textarea.md, /md/mobile/textarea.md.
- [ThemeToggle](/components/m3/theme-toggle): One action that switches the color scheme between light and dark. Tier: Component (composite). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/theme-toggle.md, /md/mobile/theme-toggle.md.
- [Top app bar](/components/m3/top-app-bar): The top app bar is the screen's header — leading slot, title, trailing actions — plus the app-level bar and its menus. Tier: Component (composite). Renders: Web + Native. Markdown: /md/web/top-app-bar.md, /md/mobile/top-app-bar.md.
- [TopBar](/components/m3/top-bar): TopBar is a responsive site header with a brand link, primary navigation, and an actions slot. Tier: Component (composite). Renders: Web. Markdown: /md/web/top-bar.md.

## Blocks

- [Sign-in form](/blocks/auth-form): A sign-in card: labelled email field with helper text, password input, submit action. Reach for it when sign-in is one card, not a page. Category: Auth. Install: `kern add auth-form`.
- [Billing page](/blocks/billing): A billing page: Growth-plan slot with status pill plus a display-only invoice ledger. Reach for it when billing is plan display plus invoice history, never payment actions. Category: Billing. Install: `kern add billing`.
- [Dashboard page](/blocks/dashboard): A dashboard page: stat cards, activity feed and an ops queue table. Reach for it when the page is figures plus feed plus queue. Category: Dashboard. Install: `kern add dashboard`.
- [Empty search state](/blocks/empty-search): A no-results state: titled empty state with a clear-search action. Reach for it when a search or filter yields nothing. Category: Dashboard. Install: `kern add empty-search`.
- [Settings screen](/blocks/settings-screen): A settings page: labelled rows with supporting text and trailing controls, in a filled card. Reach for it when settings are rows of label plus control. Category: Settings. Install: `kern add settings-screen`.
- [Sign-up page](/blocks/signup): A sign-up page: name, email and password fields in a filled card with a submit action. Reach for it when sign-up is one card, not a flow. Category: Auth. Install: `kern add signup`.
